title: Can ABA therapy and occupational therapy be combined?
metaTitle: Combining ABA and Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how the interdisciplinary approach at Pinnacle Blooms Network effectively combines ABA and Occupational Therapy to address both behavioral changes and life-skills for a child with autism.
html: Most definitely! At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we adopt an interdisciplinary approach which allows us to seamlessly integrate ABA therapy with occupational therapy. This holistic treatment strategy empowers us to tackle behavioral changes, improve life-skills, and foster independence for your child. By focusing both on specific behaviors and daily living activities, we aim to maximize your child's potential in all aspects of life.
